scientific_integrity: Direct generator definition and self-contained analytical proof; source publication date is the first arXiv submission, not a subsequent revision. Earlier source results on generator, sectors and stationary distribution are explicitly credited. Independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Binary two-label twisted SSEP on a finite ring of length at least three, unit rates, and a fixed uniform parity sector; no higher-order correlation theorem, no general twist, no arbitrary-rate or full interacting spectral-gap claim. Numerical checks are finite supplements, not proof of the infinite quantified theorem.
title: An all-time correlation sign wall in the binary twisted exclusion ring
